title: Billing and Coding: Special EEG Tests

codes.1: Note: Providers are reminded to refer to the long descriptors of the CPT codes in their CPT book.

covered.1: It is the provider’s responsibility to select codes carried out to the highest level of specificity and selected from the ICD-10-CM code book appropriate to the year in which the service is rendered for the claim(s) submitted. The following ICD-10-CM codes support medical necessity and provide coverage for CPT codes: 95700, 95705, 95706, 95707, 95708, 95709, 95710, 95711, 95712, 95713, 95714, 95715, 95716, 95717, 95718, 95719, 95720, 95721, 95722, 95723, 95724, 95725, 95726, and 95957.

noncovered.1: All those not listed under the “ICD-10 Codes that Support Medical Necessity” section of this article.
